# iAppleCareCenter Bangalore

Authorized Apple Service Center in Bangalore specializing in professional repairs and service for the full range of Apple products, including iPhone, MacBook, iPad, iMac, Apple Watch, and AirPods.

## Core Services

- **MacBook Repairs**: Screen and display replacement, battery replacement, keyboard & trackpad repair, motherboard logic board service, and SSD upgrades.
- **iPhone Repairs**: Screen and glass replacement, battery replacements, charging issues, camera and speaker service, water damage restoration.
- **iMac Repairs**: Display troubleshooting, storage upgrades, system diagnostics, and power supply repairs.
- **Apple Watch Repairs**: Screen repairs, battery replacement, diagnostics.
- **AirPods Repairs**: Charging case issues, sound quality troubleshooting, connectivity fixes.
